metadata.timing_scope: One complete single-signal decomposition. Includes weights, padding, iteration, residual updates and GD per-stage thread-pool creation. Excludes imports, lookup-table creation, input generation, validation, population fitting, diagnostics and plots.
metadata.threading: GD uses ThreadPoolExecutor over disjoint contiguous target chunks, minimum 64 targets/chunk. Stages remain sequential. QuantLet uses one worker only.
metadata.warmup: One untimed complete decomposition per method per case at one worker.
metadata.repetitions: Same input per case; deterministic shuffled execution order within each timing repetition; configurations never run concurrently.

scope_revision.description: Retained original GD measurements and QuantLet one-worker measurements only. Timing values and measurement-time source hashes are unchanged. The current adapter removes QuantLet threading; its hash is recorded separately below.
